title: ci: split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache and repo hygiene
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and brittle; lint/test/release steps often interfere with caching and cause long queue times. This PR splits the single ci.yml into focused workflows (lint, test, release) to improve parallelism and cache locality, consolidates reusable job templates, bumps several GH Actions to latest minor versions, and cleans up legacy steps introduced during the 2024 pipeline migration. Changes include: 1) split workflows so lint runs on pull_request for changed language files, test matrix runs only when src/ or packages/ change, release workflow triggers on tag and manual dispatch; 2) introduce a shared workflow-templates directory and re-usable composite actions to reduce duplication; 3) optimize caching keys for node/npm/pnpm to reduce cold-cache misses and add a controlled cache-ttl strategy; 4) upgrade actions/checkout@v4 -> v4.1 and actions/cache@v4 -> v4.2, and update node-setup to support Node 20 while keeping compatibility with legacy Node 18 test runners; 5) repo hygiene: remove deprecated build-publish step, update README CI badges, and add short troubleshooting docs for common CI flakiness. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows created and smoke-tested - [x] Back-compat triggers preserved for release branches - [x] Cache hit-rate validated on a small matrix - [x] Bumped GH Actions and tools with release notes reviewed - [x] Reviewers sign-off and CI green Implementation notes: Most changes are in .github/workflows/* and .github/workflow-templates/*, with small adapters in package.json scripts to better expose deterministic build hashes. This PR is non-breaking; follow-up will track fine-grained runner sizing under ENG-598.
commits: 4 commits: 1) split ci into lint.yml test.yml release.yml and add workflow-templates; 2) introduce composite actions for node-setup and cache-handling; 3) upgrade GH Actions versions and adjust workflows for Node 20; 4) repo hygiene: remove legacy build step and update docs.
review_thread: Liam: please verify cache keys are stable across matrix entries. Author: adjusted keys to include OS and node-version and added short TTL to avoid stale restore. Priya: can we avoid running full tests on docs-only changes? Author: added path filters to test.yml to skip on docs-only. Marcus: request to pin actions to minor versions - done for actions/cache@v4.2 and actions/checkout@v4.1. Final approvals after CI rerun.
ci_checks: Initial run: lint failed (fixed ESLint rule mismatch), tests flaky on windows runner (restarted), second run: all checks passed: lint, unit, integration, eslint, typecheck, release dry-run. Cache hit rate observed: warm runs ~92% for node modules, first cold run improved by optimized keys. No flaky tests reported post-fix.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash after approvals from Liam and Priya. Release workflow remains gated and was not executed on merge. Post-merge: created a small follow-up ENG-598 to track runner sizing and release job parallelism.
release_notes: Split CI into focused workflows (lint, test, release), added reusable workflow templates, optimized cache keys and GH Action versions, removed legacy build-publish step, improved CI docs and troubleshooting. No user-facing changes.
notes: This PR reduces CI runtime for PRs touching code by ~25% in our sample matrix and dramatically improves cache hit stability. Follow-ups: monitor action-version churn and add integration with SLO toolkit alerts for CI latency.
